name: Dynatrace
summary: Dynatrace charges by memory used per hour. Full-Stack Monitoring costs $58 a month for an 8 GiB host, at $0.01 per memory GiB-hour, and includes APM and code-level profiling. Traces cost $0.20 per GiB to ingest. A 15-day free trial is listed.

facts.text: Dynatrace learns baselines that include the response times of applications and services, and notifies users of detected problems in real time.
Full-Stack Monitoring includes APM, code-level profiling and 10 days of trace retention.
Usage draws down from a minimum annual spend commitment at platform level, and the page says Dynatrace never charges penalty-style overages.

plans.name: Full-Stack Monitoring
plans.notes: Billed at $0.01 per memory GiB-hour. Includes APM, code-level profiling and 10 days of trace retention

hiddenCosts: Traces cost $0.20 per GiB to ingest and process, $0.0007 per GiB-day to retain and $0.0035 per GiB scanned to query.
Metrics cost $0.15 per 100,000 datapoints to ingest and process.
The platform subscription needs a minimum annual spend commitment, and larger commitments lower unit prices.
Memory-based pricing means a host with more memory costs proportionally more than the 8 GiB example.
